items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1972-04-05
items.q: I played more with Frankie Deucing, with, uh, Edward Clemmen, them, with that Pelican band. I played a long time with them.

ctx.x: What about that other guy out there, Dierrensberg? Caffrey Dierrensberg? Do you know him? Did you know Caffrey? Caffrey? Yeah, he played. He and Percy both played banjo. Percy, Percy Alfred? No. No, Percy Dierrensberg. Oh. There were two brothers. There was a player with you from the... Well didn't he play with... Perares. Perares at the Pythian Temple. You'd know him if you saw him. Well you wouldn't recognize him now, he's dead. Anyway... If you saw his picture, you'd know him. I'll show you his picture. And…

He played banjo. He was a good banjo player. He played with uh... with our band and the Pelican band with Edward Clemmen too, you see. Oh. Yeah. After, yeah, Edward Clemmen uh... got him on banjo and me on the bass.
But you didn't hear him on mandolin, huh?
